hana: starting quiet-window deploy for model-router v2.7. toggling featureflag route_signal_v2 with staggered telemetry-gated rollout. plan: 0 -> 0.03 (canary 8 hosts) -> 0.2 -> 0.6 -> 1.0 over 45m. enterprise and gov cohorts pinned to model=v2.3 until final green. release notes: https://internal.redwood/releases/2026-03-24/model-router-v2.7

 diego: ack. put deploybot holdpoint after 0.2. gates: error_rate > 1.5% OR p95 latency +28% OR model-quality drift > 1.0% -> pause and escalate. also watch cache-hit ratio and fallback-rate. enable soft-session-drain 9m for canary nodes. :thumbsup:

 deploybot: automated: created canary pool H (8 hosts). route_signal_v2 -> 0.03. telemetry stream /ops/telemetry/deploy/7923450000 active. holdpoint scheduled at step 3.

 sara: smoke tests (smoke_lite) and evals (regression_llm_b) running. quality gate: rouge_delta <= 0.9% and exact-match loss <= 1.1%. sampling traces enabled at 3% for early diagnostics.

 hana: routing-pin applied: enterprise+gov -> model=v2.3 enforced until final gate. note in runbook and support playbook.

 diego: quick rollback snippet for ops clipboard:
```
# revert flag and drain canary pool
curl -s -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://api.redwood/flags/route_signal_v2 -d '{"value":0}'
deploybot action: drain --pool canaryH --grace 540
```

 deploybot: canary H metrics @ +6m: error_rate=0.9% p95=240ms (+13%) token_cost=+5% fallback_rate=0.6% rouge_delta=+0.2% -> within gates. proceeding to 0.2 in 8m.

 infra-bot: autoscale headroom +18% GPU scheduled at +15m.

 hana: FYI posting concise release note to #release-notes after final gate. notifying #support and #eng-oncall. if any metric flaps, diego will fast-drain and pin routing back.

 deploybot: scheduled promote to 1.0 at 01:10 UTC unless holdpoint triggered. next update in ~10m or on gate trip. :eyes:
